description: This Java source file defines the EwayServices class, providing methods for processing payments, refunds, and releases via the eWAY payment gateway within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for charging, refunding, and releasing transactions, utilizing external classes for gateway communication and entity management.

classes.name: EwayServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling eWAY payment gateway operations such as charge, refund, and release within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ewayCharge
methods.description: Processes a payment charge through eWAY, including setting up the request with card and billing details, sending it, and returning the transaction result.

methods.name: ewayRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund transaction via eWAY, retrieving the original transaction, preparing the refund request, and returning the outcome.

methods.name: ewayRelease
methods.description: Releases (refunds) a previously authorized transaction, preparing and sending the release request, and returning the result.

methods.name: initRequest
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayRequest object with configuration parameters for either a charge or refund operation.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the payment gateway, either from the database or properties files.
